lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Hello. My name is Trunks. And this... is my story.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I mean, I was a baby during this part, so... the details are a little unclear.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I am told those were my first words.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But he just got back from his training!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And with the death of Goku, his family and friends were left to mourn... for approximately six months.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey girl, how you—WAAH!! MY EYES!!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Leaving the fate of the Earth... with little hope.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Over the next thirteen years, the Androids would destroy small town after small town, working their way up.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Maybe that's why we reacted the way we did.
The word "wombat" echoes while slowing down, followed by a woman saying, "Me so horny".

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: Starting us off this hour with sports: The College Battleball Association has had to disband ENTIRELY.

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: As most of its players and associate colleges have been destroyed by the Cyborgs.

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: Speaking of which! In Cyborg News...
Audio clips of a child's laughter, gunshots, and a woman moaning

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: As we currently speak, Paprikaburg is under siege by the mechanical threat!

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: But on the brighter side — ♪ Wombat's getting married! ♪ Ha ha ha!
Audio clips of cheering, wedding music, and a woman moaning

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: That's right! Unfortunately, my beloved fiancée resides in Paprikaburg... and is probably, most certainly dying as we speak.
Audio clips of a collective "Aww" of disappointment, funeral music, and a woman moaning

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: But — silver lining — I'M SINGLE AGAIN!
Cheerful music plays before Bulma changes the channel to techno-rock.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Mom? Do you believe in destiny?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Paprikaburg is only thirty miles from here. If I hurry, I could save someone.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Or you could die like your father.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Why do you say that every time I want to go fight them?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Because YOU are 13, I'm 37, and I am all alone.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: My mother had been 37 for ten years...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: No means no. End of discus—

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh! No! Just, just fly away! That's fine!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: No, you said, "Hey, check this shit out!", then jumped in a car.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Aw, come on, sis! Is this about the shop earlier?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Oh, man, you wouldn't *believe* this haul!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: This is why I love these little inner-city shops; they always have the best brands.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: What the hell?! Why did you blow it up?! They were giving me free clothes!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: It was a woman's clothing store.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Is that why you dye your hair?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I wasn't sure if I'd be able to do anything at all... but I had to at least try to stop their chaos.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: But... as I walked the ruins of that demolished city... a hero appeared!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: The hero of my time: Gohan!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And face-to-face with him, all I could say was...

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: Gohan they keep destroying cities and I don't know how to stop them and now everybody's de-he-head!

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: You remember a time before this, Gohan...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: When I was a toddler, my Uncle showed up, kidnapped me, and then Mr. Piccolo killed him and my Dad.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Then *Mr. Piccolo* kidnapped me, the Saiyans showed up, killed a bunch of people — including Mr. Piccolo...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: then we went to Namek, a bunch more people died, we came back, then my Dad died *again*,

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: then all my friends died, and now everyone else is dying.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: Well, I can help! I'm half-Saiyan, just like you!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I said from now on, you shall be my pupil... and you will call me Mr. Gohan!

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: Oh! OK. Would you like to stay for dinner, Mr. Gohan?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Or should I change my dating profile from "Single Mother" to just "Single"? Because one gets more hits— oh... Gohan! Long time no see!

lines.speaker: Single Mother
lines.text: We got plenty of room here but, you know... no extra beds, so...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, worth a shot. Who's hungry?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: You wouldn't believe how hard it is to get produce nowadays. Luckily, we have our own greenhouses.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Don't ask me where I get the protein from, though.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, you are *just* like your father...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, you're strong, and brave, and look at you in that gi.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: It was the only thing he left me.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Over the next few weeks, Gohan would begin training me, focusing on making me a Super Saiyan like him.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: The whirlpool's too strong! I can't swim!

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: Maybe... I can build a raft!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: You know, if you think I'm rough, you should have trained with Mr. Piccolo.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: You really looked up to him, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Yeah. He was like the father I never had.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: You know, speaking of dads... Mom never talks about mine...

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: You knew him, right? What was he like?

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: So what!? You think having a dad who's a Super Saiyan makes you better than me!?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Gohan would never talk much about his family.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Apparently, his mother and grandfather lived alone in the woods.

lines.speaker: Ox King
lines.text: And I've got groceries! H-how are you doing, sweetheart?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I should be a grandmother, you know.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I should be a grandmother, with a Nobel Prize-winning son. But what am I?

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: A widow... with a son who never talks to me and is possibly dead.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: So I'm just gonna sit here, and knit this baby sweater.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Will dinner bring my husband back!?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Gohan would continue pushing me harder and harder, day and night, to become a Super Saiyan.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: That's it. Look at him, Mr. Piccolo — he's almost ready.

lines.speaker: Mr. Piccolo
lines.text: 'I think the only real training you'll ever get in this world... is on the battlefield.'

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: The next day, the Cyborgs would attack Super World.

lines.speaker: Announcer
lines.text: Hello, and welcome to Super World! "Slogan pending!"

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Huh? E-e-e-excuse me, you two! Y-y-you can't cut the line!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Do... you not know who we are?

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: If you'd like to get on the rides faster, we do have a Fast Pass system that's only 7900 zen--

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: This is why I hate theme parks.
People flee the park, screaming in terror

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Yeah, you know, when you can fly, these rides don't really seem that fun.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Well, if you're already bored, why not try taking a ride on my fist?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: ...*Wow*. You, uh, want a minute to rephrase that there, chief?

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Nope! I'd rather take that minute to kick your ass!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Now, Trunks, I want you to just sit back and spectate!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Unless they team up on me, in which case — jump in.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: I can't help but feel like I'm woefully unprepared for this.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: And that's *exactly* what we prepared for!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: This would be my first real battle. And I'd never seen anyone fight so fiercely!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Gohan had always told his stories about the fights in the past... but those had a lot more screaming and posturing.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: But, as soon as Gohan gained the upper hand...

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: You think it's his time of the month?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Ha! Ah, it's funny 'cause you're a chick!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I can't believe you brought a kid to a battle!

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: I'm not afraid of you! I can take care of you myself!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Oh shit oh shit oh shit oh shit oh shit!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Well, shit. Think he got away?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I don't know; we can't sense life energy.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Seriously, what was the point of not giving us that ability?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Seems like an intentional design flaw if you ask me.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Oh, everything's in pain. Ugh, everything but my left ar--

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Ugh, aagh, too bad I'm not a Namekian. Be reeaally handy right about now...

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: 'But I'll just settle on the next best thing and use the Senzu Beans!'

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: (Sigh) What is it, Trun—OH, MY GOD!

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: What do you know about reattaching arms?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: So... have you learned anything today?

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: The only good Cyborg is a dead Cyborg?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: (Sigh)... You really are your father's son...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Now stronger and more motivated than ever, I was back to training as soon as Gohan was able again.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Though I think he was still a little... sore.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Come on, Trunks! Just imagine losing someone or something close to you!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Like your arm! 'Cause trust me... THAT REALLY FRIGGIN' SUCKS!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Unfortunately... I wouldn't transform in time.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: So, Gohan — do you usually hang out in wastelands?

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: What do you mean? This is where I live.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: I think you're really close, you know. You just need something to push you over the edge...

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: Well, you always tell me to use the pain of loss.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: But... I've never really lost anyone.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: For me, it's my greatest source of anger.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: I just think about losing Krillin or Mr. Piccolo--

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: And then it just builds up inside until finally... it explodes.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: The Cyborgs! Mr. Gohan, we have to go!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: No, Trunks! You stay here this time. We both know you're not ready.

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: Mr. Gohan, you only have one arm! What can you do with one arm?!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: You know what? You're right. What can I do with only one arm?

lines.speaker: Young Trunks
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Gohan! I will not let you dow—

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: *That*. I can do that with one arm.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: 'Now... what can I do to the *Cyborgs* with one arm...?'

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Well, we could find another city.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: No, I mean, like... bored of this whole "Great Destroyer" shtick, you know?

lines.speaker: Mr. Piccolo
lines.text: Destroying things, killing people... it's just boring.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Yeah, it's kinda lost its luster.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: After you wipe an entire genre of music off the face of the Earth, what's left?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: You know what I always wanted to do? Like, since before all this?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: You want to range a park?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Hell yeah! Livin' outdoors, communicatin' with nature, shootin' poachers...

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Yeah. I think I'ma do tha—

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: YOU GODDAMN CHEAP SON OF A BITCH!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: OK! You know what? That's it! I'm killing every human!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Then I'm gonna range the shit out of that park!

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: Neither of you are leaving here alive! I'm stronger than I was before!

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Yeah; also lighter. Looks like you dropped some weight since last time.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Five, ten pounds? I don't know; how much does an arm weigh?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Gotta hand it to you, though.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Pretty ballsy coming after us all asymmetrical like that.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: But four hands are better than one.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Long story short: You're gonna die.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: No! This isn't where my story ends!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: This is where Gohan's story ends.

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: 'Ahhh, well... this is it, Mr. Piccolo...'

lines.speaker: Mr. Gohan
lines.text: 'But at least we still have Trunks. I trained him just like you wanted.'

lines.speaker: Mr. Piccolo
lines.text: 'You know I'm not actually here, right?'

lines.speaker: Slightly Older Trunks
lines.text: Alright, Mom. I got the rest of the supplies for the Time Machine.

lines.speaker: Slightly Older Trunks
lines.text: It's too bad Grandpa isn't here to help you build it.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Yeah. Unfortunately, he's still off searching the cosmos for New Namek.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: So until your Grandpa returns — just me.

lines.speaker: Radio
lines.text: (Static) Hello! This is an emergency broadcast from Cuminopolis!

lines.speaker: Radio
lines.text: The Cyborgs are attacking! And they are sparing no one!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Trunks, I know what you're thinking, but let me just finish the Time Machine—

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Listen! I'm stronger now! I'm a Super Saiyan!
Vegeta yelling from another planet... and timeline

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: So was Gohan, and look how that turned out!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Oh, so now you're just replacing Dad with *Gohan*?
Disturbed silence, except for Vegeta's yelling (which fades out)

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And so, armed with the sword given to me by Tapion... which is a whole... other story...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I raced off to fight the Cyborgs... one last time.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Yep! Looks like we're out of people to kill here.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Wait, did you just *ask* us to kill you?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I'm sorry, do we know you?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: To this day, I'm still not sure why I did what I did.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Maybe, I just had something to prove.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: A young half-blood Super Saiyan, armed with nothing but a sword and his guts.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Unfortunately... half-human and half-Saiyan... might just be analogous to half-brave, and half-stupid.

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Hey! Doesn't he kinda remind you of you-know-who?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Now that you mention it, I do see the resemblance... but unlike good ol' Righty, he's still got both arms.

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Hey, Sunshine. Cough if you're still alive.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Why? Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: The question isn't "Why?", kid. It's "Why not?"

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: I mean... who's going to stop us?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Not those guys seventeen years ago.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: You evil bunch of jerks, I'll kick your God damn...

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Although now it's kind of annoying.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: WHY? WHY? WHY? WHY? WHY? WHY?

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Wait a sec... this kid look familiar to you, sis?

lines.speaker: Android 18
lines.text: Yeah...! He was at the amusement park with Stumpy!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Aww, who's a little survivor? You are! Yes, you are!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: You stepped in *front* of it! What is *wrong* with you?!

lines.speaker: Android 17
lines.text: Oh come on, *sis*! ...Sis, get back here!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I still have *no idea* how I survived...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, I finished the Time Machine.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Yeeeaah, which means you got two options: You take another swing at the Cyborgs...

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Or you use the Time Machine to go save Goku.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: After recovering a few months, I was finally ready.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Aww! My jacket looks so good on you. All the girls in the past are just gonna love it.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: So this is it! I can't believe I finally get to meet history's greatest hero!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Yeah... Goku might not be exactly how you think, so do temper your expectations.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: And Dad! I finally get to meet Dad!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: I mean, just be yourself, sweetie, and everything will turn out okay!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Next time you see me... this'll be a Cyborg-free world!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: ...Unless this actually operates on Multiverse Theory, in which case—

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Can't hear you, Mom; Time Machine!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Alright, they haven't been back in two days.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: I can't believe they took my house...

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: I'm going in for a food run. All that's left is the Spam and the pork rinds...

lines.speaker: Puar
lines.text: We both knew this day would come, Oolong!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: I have long since made peace with this. I'm just glad we're still alive.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: All thanks to my submarine: The "U.S.S. M'Dick"!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: Knew it, I friggin' knew it!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: HOW DOES IT FEEL RIDING M'DICK!?!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: *Seventeen years*! Seventeen years you've been holding on to that one!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: You don't know the patience I have...

segments.title: Dad Dead! Dad Dead!
segments.quote: Dad dead! Dad dead! / I am told those were my first words.

segments.title: 13 Going on 37
segments.quote: Because YOU are 13, I'm 37, and I am all alone. / My mother had been 37 for ten years...

segments.title: Call Me Mr. Gohan
segments.quote: From now on, you shall be my pupil... and you will call me Mr. Gohan! / Mr. Gohan would!

segments.title: WRONG ANSWER
segments.quote: You think having a dad who's a Super Saiyan makes you better than me!? / WRONG ANSWER!

segments.title: Scorched Earth
segments.quote: Seems like an intentional design flaw if you ask me. / Oh well. Scorched Earth? / Scorched Earth.

segments.title: Range the Shit Out of That Park
segments.quote: You want to range a park? / Hell yeah! ... I'm killing every human! Then I'm gonna range the shit out of that park!

segments.title: How Much Does an Arm Weigh?
segments.quote: Looks like you dropped some weight since last time. ... Long story short: You're gonna die.

segments.title: This Is Where Gohan's Story Ends
segments.quote: 'This is it, Mr. Piccolo...' / 'You know I'm not actually here, right?' / 'Ah... crapbaskets...'

segments.title: WHY? WHY? WHY?
segments.quote: You evil bunch of jerks... / This is hilarious! / And now it's annoying again.

segments.title: Multiverse Theory
segments.quote: Can't hear you, Mom; Time Machine! / ...Aaand Multiverse Theory it is. Shit!

segments.title: The U.S.S. M'Dick
segments.quote: All thanks to my submarine: The "U.S.S. M'Dick"! ... HOW DOES IT FEEL RIDING M'DICK!?!
